errors.timeout: Nucleus Co-op did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong in Nucleus Co-op. The details are in the app log.
errors.methodNotFound: This version of Nucleus Co-op cannot do that yet.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.

startup.mismatchTitle: UI and app versions don't match
startup.mismatchMessage: The interface files of this install were not built for Nucleus Co-op {version}. Reinstall Nucleus Co-op to get matching files.
startup.hostDownMessage: The interface could not reach the app ({error}). Close Nucleus Co-op and start it again.

titleBar.setupDevices: Players and devices in this setup
titleBar.vibrateHint: {label}. Click to make the gamepad vibrate.
titleBar.noControllerHint: No controller seen yet. Press a button on a controller to show it here.

firstRun.title: Choose your language
firstRun.description: Nucleus Co-op shows its windows and messages in this language. You can change it at any time in Settings.

general.title: General
general.description: Language, network and Windows user accounts used by game instances.

players.title: Players
players.description: How gamepads are assigned to players. Nicknames and Steam IDs are edited with the player list.

hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
hotkeys.description: Shortcuts available during a game session. Changes apply from the next session.

gamepad.title: Gamepad shortcuts
gamepad.description: Button combinations available during a game session (XInput gamepads). Steam Input may interfere with them. The Nucleus window itself works with any gamepad: D-pad or left stick to move, A to select, B to go back, right stick to scroll.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Playback device of each game instance. This may not work with every game.
audio.descriptionWithDefault: Playback device of each game instance. This may not work with every game. Default playback device: {device}.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Defaults of the custom screen layout, split-screen background, cutscenes mode and Windows merger. Profiles keep their own copy.

appLanguage.label: Language
appLanguage.description: Language of Nucleus Co-op's windows and messages. Handler notes and game names stay as their authors wrote them.

steamLanguage.label: Steam language
steamLanguage.description: Language reported by the Steam emulator. A game can override it from its menu.

epicLanguage.label: Epic / GOG language
epicLanguage.description: Language reported by the Epic and GOG emulators.

network.label: Network adapter
network.description: Adapter used by handlers that change the IP address of each instance.

useNicknames.label: Use nicknames in game
useNicknames.description: Player nicknames are passed to the game when the handler supports it.

keepAccounts.label: Keep Nucleus user accounts
keepAccounts.description: Keeps the Windows user accounts Nucleus creates for some games. When off, the next game that uses them deletes them with their files and saves.

confirm.title: Turn off Keep Nucleus user accounts?
confirm.message: The next time you run a game that uses separate Windows user accounts, Nucleus deletes every account it created, with their files and saves.

nucleusAccountPassword.label: Nucleus user accounts password
nucleusAccountPassword.description: Password of the Windows accounts Nucleus creates. Stored in plain text in Settings.ini. 12345 or empty uses the built-in password.

autoDesktopScaling.label: Set desktop scale to 100% during sessions
autoDesktopScaling.description: Some games need 100% display scaling to place their windows correctly.

fastLaunch.label: Fast launch
fastLaunch.description: Starts each instance as soon as the previous one is ready instead of always waiting the handler's full pauses. Turn it off if a game stops launching correctly.

ignoreInputLockReminder.label: Don't remind me to lock inputs
ignoreInputLockReminder.description: When off, a message at launch explains how to lock keyboard and mouse input.

debugLog.label: Enable debug log
debugLog.description: Writes debug-log.txt in the Nucleus folder. Turned off automatically when the log grows past 150 KB.

disableGameProfiles.label: Disable game profiles
disableGameProfiles.description: Nucleus uses these global settings instead of per-game profiles.

assignGamepadsByIndex.label: Assign gamepads by index
assignGamepadsByIndex.description: Default for new games: profiles store gamepad API indexes instead of hardware ids (some handlers turn it off). Switching modes can prevent older profiles from loading.

assignGamepadsOnButtonPress.label: Assign gamepads on button press
assignGamepadsOnButtonPress.description: Default for new games: profiles assign gamepads when players press a button instead of reusing the saved ones. Works well with custom nicknames.

switchMergerWindow.label: Switch merged window
switchMergerWindow.description: With the Windows merger: each press brings another game window to the front (like Alt+Tab).

lockInputs.label: Lock inputs key
lockInputs.description: Locks and unlocks keyboard and mouse input during a session (no modifier).

releaseCursor.description: Sends Alt+Tab to get the cursor out of a game window.

type.label: Gamepad type
type.description: Button names and pictures shown for the shortcuts.

choices.sameDevice: Use the default playback device for every instance
choices.perInstance: Choose a device for each instance

instance.label: Instance {number}
instance.description: Used when "Choose a device for each instance" is selected.

verticalLines.label: Vertical divisions
verticalLines.description: Columns of the custom layout grid, minus one.

horizontalLines.label: Horizontal divisions
horizontalLines.description: Rows of the custom layout grid, minus one. Maximum players = (horizontal + 1) × (vertical + 1).

splitDiv.label: Split-screen division
splitDiv.description: Fills the screen behind the game windows with a colour. May not work for all games.

hideDesktopOnly.label: Hide desktop only
hideDesktopOnly.description: Only shows the background window, without resizing or moving the game windows.

cutscenesMuteAudioOnly.label: Cutscenes mode: mute audio only
cutscenesMuteAudioOnly.description: Can't be combined with the two options below.

cutscenesKeepAspectRatio.label: Cutscenes mode: keep original window size

windowsMerger.label: Windows merger
windowsMerger.description: Merges the game windows into one window, so Lossless Scaling can be used. Multiple monitors are not supported yet.

losslessHook.label: Lossless hook
losslessHook.description: Lossless Scaling keeps upscaling when another window gets the focus (for games that need real focus to receive input).

mergerResolution.label: Windows merger resolution
mergerResolution.description: Size of the merged window. Defaults to the primary screen.

rules.gamepadAssignment: "Assign gamepads by index" and "Assign gamepads on button press" can't both be on.
rules.cutscenesMuteAudioOnly: "Mute audio only" can't be combined with the other cutscenes mode options.

errors.choice: Choose one of the listed values.
errors.codePage: Some characters can't be saved in Settings.ini on this PC (it uses the system code page).
errors.hotkeyFormat: Use one modifier and one key, for example Ctrl+Q.
errors.hotkeyModifier: The modifier must be Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
errors.hotkeyKey: The key must be a single letter or digit.
errors.twoButtons: Use a combination of two buttons, for example Guide + Y.
errors.unknownButton: '{code}' is not a gamepad button code.
errors.bothTriggers: Both triggers can't be combined: use a trigger with a button.

errors.steamIdFormat: A Steam ID is 17 digits, for example 76561199075562883.
errors.nicknameInUse: This nickname is already used by player {number}.
errors.steamIdInUse: This Steam ID is already used by player {number}.
errors.nicknameCharacters: Nicknames are used as folder names: avoid \ / : * ? " < > |.

notes.label: Handler Author's Notes
notes.description: Shows the notes written by the handler's author.

details.label: Nucleus Game Details
details.description: Executable, architecture, handler file, content folder and supported inputs.

openHandler.label: Open Game Handler
openHandler.description: Opens the handler script in your text editor.

openExeFolder.label: Open Original Exe Path
openExeFolder.description: Opens the folder of the game executable.

openContentFolder.label: Open Nucleus Content Folder
openContentFolder.description: Opens the folder that holds the game instances.

deleteContentFolder.label: Delete Game Content Folder
deleteContentFolder.description: Closes leftover game processes and deletes the game instances.
deleteContentFolder.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete '{folder}' and all its contents? Running {game} processes are closed first.

gameMenu.deleteFolderConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete '{folder}' and all its contents?

openBackup.label: Open Backup Folder
openBackup.description: Files the handler backs up for each player between sessions.

deleteBackup.label: Delete Backup Folder
deleteBackup.confirm: Do you really want to delete {nickname}'s backup folder of {game}?

useApiIndex.label: Assign Gamepads By Index
useApiIndex.description: Profiles store gamepad API indexes instead of hardware ids. Turns off assignment on button press.

useGamepadButtonPress.label: Assign Gamepads On Button Press (profile)
useGamepadButtonPress.description: Profiles assign gamepads by button press instead of reusing the saved ones. Turns off assignment by index.

useApiIndexForGuests.label: Assign Gamepads By Index For Guests Only
useApiIndexForGuests.description: Only guest players (several players per instance) are assigned by API index.

keepInstancesFolder.label: Keep Instances Content Folder
keepInstancesFolder.description: Keeps the game instances when the game is selected again or the session ends, instead of rebuilding them.

disableProfiles.label: Disable Profile
disableProfiles.description: Turns profiles off for this game: the global settings are used instead.

disableHandlerUpdate.label: Disable Handler Update
disableHandlerUpdate.description: Stops checking the hub for newer versions of this handler.

changeIcon.label: Change Game Icon
changeIcon.description: Pick an image or an executable to use as the game icon.

steamLanguage.label: Steam Language
steamLanguage.description: Language reported by the Steam emulator for this game. "{appSetting}" uses the global setting.

remove.label: Remove Game From List
remove.description: Removes the game from the library. The handler stays installed.
remove.confirm: Are you sure you want to remove {game} from your library? The handler stays installed.
